A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TriFlow research. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F support reliable comparison, including matching content relocated between pages.

before.justification: V1 reports original mesh-generation experiments, benchmark comparisons, human and VLM evaluations, ablations, and appendix results on generalization and higher-resolution modeling.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results and additionally reports a quantitative control-precision analysis on 100 Objaverse test samples.

M1.justification: The NVF representation, autoencoders, latent flow matching, watershed extraction, constrained QEM, and augmentation remain unchanged. V3 explains pipeline roles and NVF ambiguity without specifying a changed algorithm or tie-breaking procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Objaverse meshes, TRELLIS-generated geometry, and Hunyuan3D-2.1 outputs, including LOD and higher-resolution settings. The added control-precision analysis uses existing Objaverse coverage and the same mesh-generation task.

E2.justification: QEM, QuadriFlow, MeshMosaic, and TreeMeshGPT remain the comparators in Tables 1, 2, and A.1. The QEM LOD comparison and existing ablation variants are retained; the new control analysis introduces no comparator.

E3.justification: Appendix E adds an evaluation on 100 Objaverse test samples targeting 1,000–8,000 faces, measuring discrepancies between requested and achieved face counts and quad ratios. Existing benchmark settings, training budgets, and perceptual-study procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The new control-precision analysis quantitatively examines adherence to user-specified topology controls, complementing the existing qualitative LOD and quad-ratio demonstrations. The previous component ablations, parameter sensitivity studies, and resolution analysis are retained.

E5.justification: Appendix E newly reports variances alongside mean control errors, adding statistical dispersion reporting across test samples. These are not repeated-seed uncertainty estimates; no increased run count, confidence intervals, or significance tests are reported.

E6.justification: V3 newly reports mean relative face-count error of -2.01% with variance 3.49%, and mean quad-ratio error of -0.21 with variance 0.01. Tables 1–3 and A.1–A.2, existing qualitative results, and higher-resolution results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix D adds a mathematical qualification: ties between maximal barycentric weights make the NVF ambiguous on region boundaries, which are stated to have surface measure zero. Existing equations and derivations remain unchanged, and no new theorem or proof is supplied.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about NVF-based topology generation, latent flow matching, robust extraction, generalization, 90% lower Chamfer Distance, and an eightfold speedup.

C2.justification: V3 distinguishes generation from topology extraction, explains face-orientation consistency through the SDF/QEM pipeline, and explicitly describes topology controls as conditioning signals rather than hard constraints. It also adds the triangle-only limitation and identifies native n-gon topology as future work.

D1.justification: V1 claims a code release without providing its project-page address; v3 adds that access information in an introduction footnote. Training hyperparameters, hardware, software dependencies, and implementation details otherwise remain unchanged. Actual online availability is not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited works and Related Work section are retained, with bibliographic access-date additions only. However, Section 4.4 adds a specific comparative distinction: TriFlow is said to preserve consistent face normals, whereas TreeMeshGPT and MeshMosaic do not reliably do so.

P1.justification: V3 makes localized explanatory additions in the method overview, experimental discussion, limitations, and Appendices D and E, plus affiliation and bibliographic edits. The section hierarchy and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Existing displays are relocated: Table 1 moves from PDF page 10 to 12, Figure 5 from 12 to 13, and Figure 7 from 13 to 14. Text and appendix prompt boxes reflow, while figure content, table structures, and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: V3 modestly improves the paper by quantifying the accuracy and variability of existing controls and explicitly acknowledging soft conditioning and triangle-only output. Pipeline clarification and the project-page address also improve documentation. The main evidence remains unchanged, and the added face-normal advantage lacks a dedicated quantitative evaluation, so the gains are limited.
